title: Test post-login physical Stream Deck button delivery

claims.statement: H-038: after graphical login, the exact physical MK.2 button event can reach the configured official Companion surface and produce a causally bound OverlayKit server observation without a virtual press.
claims.evidence: Human requirement resolved on 2026-07-25; H-037 acquisition evidence

claims.statement: This Slice does not establish pre-login availability, reconnect or reboot recovery, rendered hardware pixels, operator perception, native versus container production architecture, or OBS truth.

successCriteria.statement: The run starts after graphical login and binds Fedora 43, the exact MK.2 identity, Companion identity, device exposure, effective groups, and configured physical surface location.
successCriteria.verification: H-035/H-037 hashes plus process, surface, and configuration receipts.

successCriteria.statement: A human physical button press is observed without invoking Companion's virtual press endpoint, and the same run records the resulting Companion action and authoritative server observation.
successCriteria.verification: Physical-input window, virtual-endpoint audit, Companion surface/action receipt, server event, and causal timestamps.

successCriteria.statement: Cleanup removes temporary resources and the claim boundary excludes pixels, perception, reconnect, reboot, pre-login startup, and production support.
successCriteria.verification: Before/after cleanup and verifier claim-boundary assertions.

definitionOfDone.statement: H-038 is recorded before any physical button experiment.
No ADR, specification, service, udev rule, or production configuration is created before human evidence review.
